generalAbilities.name: Husk Mind
generalAbilities.description:
Elindrians can communicate nearly instantaneously via a primal bond similar to a formian hive mind. While within telepathic range of at least one other elindrian with husk mind, an elindrian acolyte gains a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls, Perception checks, and saving throws against mental effects. If one elindrian is aware of a combatant, all members of the husk mind within range are aware of it.

The elindrian's husk mind is integrated with their scent; for purposes of detecting other elindrians, formians, undead, or corpses, their scent is a precise sense, rather than imprecise.

An elindrian always knows the precise distance and direction to the Terror of Ukulam, so long as they're on the same plane of existence.

defensiveAbilities.name: Unfetter Allies
defensiveAbilities.description: While the elindrian acolyte is within 30 feet of another elindrian who's unable to move or act normally (such as if they're buried, Immobilized, Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, stunned, or otherwise impeded), the elindrian acolyte becomes Quickened 1 and can use the extra action to Burrow, Fly, Shove, Stride, or Strike.

cantrips.name: Daze
cantrips.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also Stunned 1.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

cantrips.name: Injury Echo
cantrips.description:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional ceil((@item.level)/2)d4 Persistent,bleed Damage damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.

cantrips.name: Read Aura
cantrips.description:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Identify Magic on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Spell Effect: Read Aura

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

cantrips.name: Seek the Stars
cantrips.description:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.

cantrips.name: Void Warp
cantrips.description:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also Enfeebled 1 until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

lv1spells.name: Enfeeble
lv1spells.description:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Enfeebled 1 until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is Enfeebled 2 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Enfeebled 3 for 1 minute.

lv1spells.name: Force Barrage
lv1spells.description:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

lv1spells.name: Mind Skewer
lv1spells.description:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also Stupefied 2 for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
